families.journal: Use case: game UI artwork assets, external review only. Produce one transparent RGBA sheet 1536x1024 containing SIX isolated cutouts in a strict 3 columns x 2 rows grid. Each cell 512x512, every piece well inside its cell with broad completely transparent gutters. Front-on orthographic flat UI artwork; no perspective, no scene. Approved reference ONLY for Direction A matte detailed storybook gouache paint, warm rural craftsmanship, muted moss/teal, cream parchment, ochre, warm brown leather/wood, subtle grain, dark clear trim. Ignore reference scene geometry and modern black UI. Elegant restrained border details and generous flat pale BLANK writing fields. No text, letters, numbers, runes, pseudo-writing, map geography, faces, logos, watermarks, ground or background. No heavy inset textures in writing areas. These are separately cropped reusable painted interface components, not a screenshot. Each item complete and not touching other items. Subjects left to right top row then bottom row: a wide open two-page journal panel with pale empty pages and slim worn leather surround; a single blank parchment entry card with restrained torn edge; a moss cloth bookmark tab; an ochre cloth bookmark tab; a small previous-page button bearing ONLY a left arrow; a small next-page button bearing ONLY a right arrow.
